additional_concerns: Footnote 3 is present: da12aecad4e68.u30.3569 states, "Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission." Both format claims incorrectly describe this authority as missing and omit its requirement. The listed formats are supported as qualified options; unconditional permission is not established.

XML submission additionally requires following the separately provided JFIU XML schema and liaison to arrange a technical test under da12aecad4e68.u14.2439. The schema and prescribed PDF form are absent. The packet's four opaque missing dependency IDs have no descriptions binding them to particular materials; no such mapping is assumed here.

The date-only candidate node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 includes filings before 9:00am on 2 February 2026. The source separately states a date-effective channel rule, a 9:00am launch, and resubmission following implementation. Preserve these competing temporal interpretations rather than treating the date-only and launch-instant rules as equivalent.

The source does not expressly establish the governing timezone or resolve the precise inclusive boundary of "following its implementation." Operational-launch candidates require that interpretation; an externally supplied temporal classification does not itself establish legal authority.

The blackout provision directs urgent contact with JFIU; it does not establish that every contact constitutes submission or provide a general post-launch alternative-channel permission. Automatic migration likewise should not be treated as a new original filing.
TRUE_IS_SATISFIED must mean that the typed duty trigger exists, not that the resubmission duty has been discharged. A later resubmission does not erase a historical trigger.

The history candidate delegates event quantification and completeness assessment to an external fact. Its Boolean formula does not independently verify either. The event candidates also differ on whether a non-submission returns FALSE or OUT_OF_SCOPE; that distinction requires an explicit input-domain interpretation.
These scoped NOT_APPLICABLE findings do not certify the resubmission formulas or authorize pruning the format and registration claims from other questions.
